spec.kitLine: Mirrors the stack count for 10 sec
spec.assertion: Isolates the burst DoT's own contribution twice — live fixture vs a STARVED world (skill1/skill2 emptied so no Ensnaring stack can exist). A mirroring model contributes <25% of full when starved; the nearest-wrong flat DoT contributes identically in both worlds and goes RED.

spec.kitLine: Cancels Ensnaring after it is triggered
spec.assertion: The engine has no 'remove DoT' primitive, so cancellation is only representable as a negative resource delta on a burst block or as Ensnaring lifetimes bounded to ~one 40s burst cycle; the assertion accepts either and fails only under permanent, never-reset stacked instances that accumulate monotonically for 180s.
